completion: Submit the complete workflow-v10 five-slot structured research record and source evidence. Return blocked with retrieval evidence only after the ordered official full-text routes have been exhausted without enough primary evidence; do not stop merely because the first successful fetch is incomplete.
instructions: Read the primary source in full. Produce a repository-quality structured research record covering problem, novelty, method, evaluation conditions, key quantitative results, limitations, implementation status, and relation to existing repository lineages. Preserve publication date/status, implementation and source URLs; for an arXiv paper, record its primary and cross-list categories from arXiv. Do not infer missing text from abstracts/search snippets. A technically successful full-text fetch is not sufficient when tables, appendices, or other evidence needed for the five slots are missing; continue through the ordered official full-text routes and use the next route only to fill the missing primary evidence. Follow workflow v10 fixed-slot transport; do not send completed Markdown from Scheduled Chat.
selection_reason: InfoKVは長い推論のprefillとdecodeで保持するKV cacheのtokenを選別・圧縮し、KVメモリを制約したLLM推論の品質を評価する手法であり、推論時圧縮・inference efficiencyの対象範囲に該当する。LongReasonでLlama-3.1-8B-InstructおよびLlama-3.2-3B-Instructの複数cache budget・context長を、またDeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B/Llama-8BでIFEval、AIME 2024、LiveCodeBenchを比較しており、単なる学習時圧縮ではない。結果はタスク性能の改善を示すが、本文で実行速度や実機メモリ削減量を測定した根拠は確認できないため、その点の優位性までは主張しない。
title: Information-Aware KV Cache Compression for Long Reasoning
